title: Tool use and structured JSON output

items.prompt:
Extract the person's details from this sentence and reply with ONLY a JSON object with the keys name (string), age (integer), city (string) and occupation (string), no other text:

"Chinedu Okafor, 27, lives in Enugu and works as a nurse."

You can call these tools:
- get_weather(city: string, day: "today" | "tomorrow")
- get_exchange_rate(from: string, to: string)

The user says: "Will it rain in Kano tomorrow?"
Reply with ONLY a JSON object of the form {"tool": <tool name>, "arguments": {...}} for the single tool call you would make.

You can call these tools:
- send_money(recipient: string, amount_naira: number)
- check_balance()

The user says: "Abeg send 5k to Musa."
Reply with ONLY a JSON object of the form {"tool": <tool name>, "arguments": {...}} for the single tool call you would make. amount_naira must be a number.

Turn this market list into a JSON array of objects with the keys item (string) and price (number, in naira, no symbols or commas). Reply with ONLY the JSON array.

Rice ₦75,000; Beans ₦45,000; Garri ₦18,000

Classify the sentiment of each review as "positive" or "negative". Reply with ONLY a JSON array of three strings, in order.

1. "The delivery came early and the food was hot. I love it!"
2. "Terrible service. They never refunded my money."
3. "Excellent quality, I will buy again."

Extract the event from this message and reply with ONLY a JSON object with the keys person, place, date (YYYY-MM-DD) and time (24-hour HH:MM):

"Meet Tunde at Ikeja City Mall on 14 March 2027 at 3pm."
Reply with ONLY a JSON object with one key, "states", whose value is an array of these three Nigerian states sorted alphabetically: Oyo, Lagos, Ogun.
Is 17 a prime number? Reply with ONLY a JSON object of the form {"answer": true} or {"answer": false}.
A receipt lists 2 bottles of water at ₦500 each and 3 packs of biscuits at ₦200 each. Reply with ONLY a JSON object {"total": <number in naira>}.
Detect the language of this text: "Ẹ káàrọ̀, ṣé dáadáa ni?". Reply with ONLY a JSON object {"language": <code>} where code is one of "en", "pcm", "yo", "ha", "ig".

Convert this order into JSON and reply with ONLY the JSON object, shaped as {"customer": {"name": string}, "items": [{"sku": string, "qty": integer}]}:

"Order for Aisha Bello: 2 × SKU A100 and 1 × SKU B205."
Reply with ONLY a JSON array of exactly 5 different Nigerian states (names as strings, without the word "State"). No other text.
